title: Shoved in the door of the closesteaming kitchen.
html_source: In this section the Dedalus sisters are home after encountering the sailor. Apparently the girls had been trying to sell Stephen’s books. The Dedalus family is quite poor. At the end of this section the poster Bloom dropped floats down the river.
